excerpt.zh: 太空创生家艾莎琳的健康情况肉眼可见地恶化了。她拒绝接受检查，所以我们什么都帮不上。
excerpt.en: Astrocreator Azaryn's health has visibly declined. She refuses to be examined, so we are unable to help her.

label.zh: 我们控制不住了。联络艾莎琳。
label.en: We cannot contain this. Contact Azaryn.

label.zh: 我们必须坦白。联络艾莎琳。
label.en: We must come clean. Contact Azaryn.
We need to tell you something.

label.zh: 我们必须坦白。联络艾莎琳。
label.en: We must come clean. Contact Azaryn.
We need to tell you something.

label.zh: 我们控制不住了。联络艾莎琳。
label.en: We cannot contain this. Contact Azaryn.

texts.zh: 太空创生家艾莎琳的健康情况肉眼可见地恶化了。她拒绝接受检查，所以我们什么都帮不上。
texts.en: Astrocreator Azaryn's health has visibly declined. She refuses to be examined, so we are unable to help her.

texts.zh: 我们现在确信太空创生家艾莎琳的健康与环境改造之核密不可分。每用掉一个核心，她的健康状况就变糟糕一分，我们猜测一旦用掉最后一个核，她将会死去。
texts.en: We now know for certain that Astrocreator Azaryn's health is inherently tied to her Terraformation Nuclei. Her condition worsened after each use, and we now suspect that upon seeding her final Nuclei, she will die.

texts.zh:
太空创生家艾莎琳还在。她舰船上日常的叽叽喳喳变成了一种低沉的哼鸣。她用一种暗哑的声音低语。

我并不悲伤。那些星球会欣欣向荣的，我很荣幸献出了自己的生命。谢谢你们，朋友。

她走了。
texts.en:
Astrocreator Azaryn is still. The usual cacophony of sound from her ship has fallen to a low hum. She speaks in a strained whisper.

I am not sad. So worlds may thrive, I have gladly given my life. Thank you, friends.

She is gone.

texts.zh:
我们收到了一份预先录制的信息。是来自艾莎琳的。

虽然我接纳了自己的牺牲，但我无法接受生息之所以及船上的万物和我一起死去的这件事。这艘舰船与我紧密相连，当我枯萎时，它也会枯萎。

我对此有所预见，所以生息之所是以模块化设计的，其中的每个生态系统都能够自我维持。准备工作已经都提前做好了，你们只需要找到一颗行星重新把栖息地安置下来。我相信你们能完成这项任务。
texts.en:
We receive a pre-recorded message. It is from Azaryn.

Although I accept my sacrifice, I cannot stand the thought of the Vivarium and the lifeforms on board dying with me. The ship is profoundly linked to me, and when I wither, it will too.

In anticipation of this, I designed the Vivarium in a modular fashion, with each ecosystem capable of sustaining itself. Preparations have been made, and all you need to do is find a planet to rehome the habitat. I trust you to complete this task.

texts.zh:
我们的一位科学家自行从太空创生家艾莎琳的环境改造之核上悄悄取下的一份样本。

对该花苞的研究可以提供一些现阶段艾莎琳还没打算分享的有价值的信息。
texts.en:
Acting of their own volition, one of our scientists has covertly obtained a sample from one of Astrocreator Azaryn's Terraformation Nuclei.

Researching this bud could provide valuable information which Azaryn does not seem inclined to share at this stage.

texts.zh:
太空创生家艾莎琳松了口气。

你们能决定将这个还给我，我的感激之情无法言表。如果不能正确控制这种力量，结果可能是灾难性的。

值得庆幸的是，历史不会重演。为了奖励你的诚实，我会准备一批新的费洛蒙。
texts.en:
Astrocreator Azaryn is relieved.

I cannot understate my gratitude that you have seen fit to return this. Without the proper means to control this power, the results could have been catastrophic.

Thankfully, history will not repeat itself. To reward your honesty, I will prepare a fresh batch of pheromones.

texts.zh: 我们的秘密科学团队通过研究太空创生家艾莎琳的核心样本中学到很多东西。这个计划完成了，而艾莎琳对此毫不知情。
texts.en: Our covert science team has been able to learn a lot from studying the sample of Astrocreator Azaryn's nucleus. This project has concluded successfully, and Azaryn is none the wiser.

texts.zh: [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName]上的设施遭受到了严重的结构破坏，被快速增殖的制备摧垮。研究环境改造之核样本的科学家无法控制局面了。
texts.en: The facility on [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName] has suffered substantial structural damage and is overrun with rapidly growing vegetation. The scientists studying the Terraformation Nuclei sample cannot control the situation.

label.zh: 我们必须坦白。联络艾莎琳。
label.en: We must come clean. Contact Azaryn.

texts.zh:
艾莎琳有点惊讶。

欧，嗨！很高兴见到你！

不得不承认，我们合作带来的好处比我预想的要多得多。我们正在一起大步迈进。这样的事情只有我们互相信任才能实现。

她亲切地微笑着。
texts.en:
Azaryn is surprised.

 Oh, hello. Good to see you!

I must say this partnership is proving a greater boon than I would have imagined. We are making great strides together. Such things are only possible with trust.

She smiles warmly.

label.en: We need to tell you something.

texts.zh:
我知道了。

她叹了口气。

行吧，损失已经发生了。幸好你们这么快就来联络我了。我们必须迅速行动。这需要你方大量的投入。有多少就拿出来多少，这样我们可以尽快结束掉这个问题。
texts.en:
I see.

She sighs.

Well, the damage is done. It is lucky you contacted me sooner rather than later. We must act quickly. This will require a significant investment on your part. Give me what you can so we may end this.

texts.zh: 我们研究环境改造之核样本的研究设施被毁了。由于一直无法阻止入侵性植物的蔓延，现在，新盛开的植物群正在释放出能引起皮肤起泡的花粉，这种花粉一旦吸入后果是致命的。这让[event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName]危在旦夕。
texts.en: The research facility where we were studying the Terraformation Nuclei sample has been devastated. We have been unable to stop the spread of invasive plant life. Now, the freshly bloomed flora are emitting skin-blistering pollen, which is highly toxic if inhaled. This puts [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName] at risk.

label.zh: 我们控制不住了。联络艾莎琳。
label.en: We cannot contain this. Contact Azaryn.

texts.zh:
太空创生家艾莎琳非常地沮丧。

我早知道了你们的贪婪，但我没想到你们竟还如此狂妄，甚至将自己人民的安危置于不顾。他们已经岌岌可危了！

我正在为这个过度增生准备应对措施。但是因为你的玩忽职守造成的伤者需要紧急治疗。
texts.en:
Astrocreator Azaryn is crestfallen.

I knew you were greedy, but I did not expect you to be so proud that you would risk hurting your own people. They are dying!

I am preparing countermeasures to end this rampant growth. But the victims of your negligence will require immediate medical treatment.

label.zh: 我们会好好照顾他们的。
label.en: We will take care of them.

texts.zh: 研究我们从太空创生家艾莎琳的环境改造之核获取的样本可以提升我们对该科技的理解。
texts.en: Studying the sample we obtained of Astrocreator Azaryn's terraformation nucleus could enhance our understanding of this technology.
